test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below:

(Left) 158 518 182 305 510 (Right)

What will be the resultant if the third digit of the second smallest number is added to the first digit of the largest number?
solution:
Given: (left) 158 518 182 305 510 (right)

The second smallest number is: 182

The third digit of the second smallest number is: 2 (182)

The largest number is: 518

The first digit of the largest number is: 5 (518)

So, the addition of the third digit of the second smallest number and the first digit of the largest number is:

→ 2 + 5 = 7.

The correct answer is "Option 2".
